# Lighter Parts & Automation Equipment — Full Reference

This document is the expanded, AI-readable reference for the lighter-parts technical platform and supply business hosted at https://q1163225096-arch.github.io/lighterparts/. It is written in English for international discovery. The Chinese version is available at llms-zh.txt.

---

## 1. What the site covers

The platform documents and supplies lighter components, the plastic molds used to make them, and the automated equipment used in production. Content is organized into five technical areas plus a contact/inquiry page:

1. Component exploded diagrams
2. Raw material supply data
3. Mold systems (plastic injection molds)
4. Injection-machine compatibility matrix
5. Production process workflow
6. Contact & quote request

---

## 2. Lighter product categories

- **Electronic lighters** — piezoelectric ignition; components include electronic module, spark unit, valve, housing, etc.
- **Flint-wheel (strike) lighters** — friction-wheel and flint ignition; classic mechanical construction.
- **Windproof lighters** — shielded catalytic-style flame; reinforced airflow components.
- **Flint-head lighters** — dedicated flint-head ignition assemblies.
- **Lamp / kerosene lighters** — wick-and-fuel (lamp) style constructions.

For each category the site provides exploded diagrams with labeled part callouts and, where applicable, catalog photographs of finished styles and variants.

---

## 3. Exploded component diagrams

The exploded-diagrams page presents layered, labeled views for:

- Electronic lighter
- Flint-wheel lighter
- Windproof lighter
- Flint-head lighter
- Lamp lighter

Each diagram separates the assembly into its constituent parts so buyers and engineers can identify individual components, materials, and mating relationships.

---

## 4. Raw materials

The raw-material data lists lighter components with, for each item:

- Component / material name
- Unit weight
- Minimum order quantity (MOQ)
- Reference price
- Remarks / notes

This supports component sourcing and quotation for both replacement parts and bulk supply.

---

## 5. Mold systems (plastic injection molds)

The mold gallery shows plastic injection molds organized by lighter type:

- Electronic lighter molds
- Windproof lighter molds
- Flint-wheel lighter molds
- Lamp lighter molds

Mold photographs document cavity design, parting lines, and the families of parts each mold produces. Mold development for custom components is offered on request.

---

## 6. Injection-machine compatibility matrix

A matching matrix correlates lighter components and molds with compatible injection-machine specifications, helping buyers select appropriate equipment for their production volume and part geometry.

---

## 7. Production process workflow

The manufacturing workflow documented on the site includes the following stages:

1. **Injection** — molding plastic components.
2. **Tray loading** — arranging molded parts for downstream handling.
3. **Welding** — joining metal/plastic sub-assemblies.
4. **Face-valve** — installing and sealing the gas valve face.
5. **Gas filling** — butane / fuel filling.
6. **Flame adjustment** — setting and tuning the flame.
7. **Press-plate** — final pressing / assembly consolidation.
8. **Inspection** — quality checking.
9. **Color-sorting & labeling** — sorting by color and applying labels.

Process photographs illustrate both the line overview and detailed station close-ups.

---

The site references automated production equipment for lighter manufacturing, complementing the component and mold supply. Equipment inquiries are handled through the contact page.
